name: Remote MCP Architecture
question: What does a 37-line MCP server need before it can run in production?
problem: measure.sh's MCP layer is 37 lines of Go. Its session-bound OAuth is 827 lines and its tool catalogue is over 2,000.
points: The protocol is JSON-RPC, and an SDK already solves it.
Remote MCP needs auth: OAuth 2.1 with short, self-revoking sessions.
Nested agent tools need recursion guards. Text-to-SQL needs schema pruning, a read-only parse, a forced tenant id and a read replica.
title: The 37-Line Remote MCP Myth: Production Architecture Teardown #shorts
